caseNameFull: Reeves, Commissioner of Revenue of Kentucky v. Williamson, Trustee
attorneys: Messrs. M. B. Holifield and H. Appleton Federa for appellant. Mr. Ben Williamson for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The appeal is dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. § 240 (b), Judicial Code, as amended, 28 U. S. C., § 347 (b); Memphis Gas Co. v. Beeler, 315 U. S. 649, 650-51. The petition for writ of certiorari is denied.
